record.paper_title: Negative Circles in Signed Graphs: A Problem Collection
record.original_question: Given a signed graph Σ, find a largest possible family of pairwise edge-disjoint positive circles in Σ.

evidence.quote: P5–8. The same as P1–4 but for edge-disjoint circles.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A signed graph is a pair Σ = (G, σ) where G = (V, E) is a finite graph (loops and multiple edges allowed) and σ : E → {+1, −1} is a sign function on its edges. A circle (also called a cycle or circuit) of Σ is the edge set of a connected 2-regular subgraph of G. The sign of a circle C is the product ∏_{e ∈ C} σ(e); the circle is called positive if this product equals +1 and negative otherwise.

A family ℱ = {C_1, C_2, …, C_k} of circles of Σ is called edge-disjoint if C_i ∩ C_j = ∅ for all i ≠ j.

Problem. Given a signed graph Σ, determine (or characterize, or give tight bounds for) the maximum cardinality
   ν⁺_e(Σ) := max { |ℱ| : ℱ is a family of pairwise edge-disjoint positive circles of Σ }.
In particular, give a structural/combinatorial formula or a min-max characterization for ν⁺_e(Σ) in terms of Σ, and develop methods (exact or approximate) for constructing a largest such edge-disjoint family of positive circles.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of packing edge-disjoint positive circles in a signed graph appears in a well-known problem collection on negative/positive circles in signed graphs and is repeatedly cited as open. While related questions (packing signatures, packing negative circles, weakly negative circle packings related to clustering) have received recent partial results, no general min-max formula or polynomial-time characterization for the maximum number of edge-disjoint positive circles is known.

status_evidence.title: Negative (and positive) circles in signed graphs: A problem collection
status_evidence.snippet: Problem collection listing packing/covering problems for positive and negative circles, including the edge-disjoint variants, as open problems.
status_evidence.claim: The edge-disjoint positive-circle packing problem is listed among open problems in a current problem collection.

status_evidence.title: Packing Signatures in Signed Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on packing problems related to signed graphs, addressing related but distinct packing questions.
status_evidence.claim: Related packing problems on signed graphs are an active topic, with the specific maximum edge-disjoint positive circle problem not resolved in general.

status_evidence.title: Weakly Negative Circles Versus Best Clustering in Signed Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Recent paper studying packings of weakly negative circles in signed graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Variants of the signed-circle packing problem remain under active investigation.
